title: Onboarding
inspection: six evenly spaced frames visually reviewed
viewport: mobile portrait; encoded pixel dimensions are not device-point dimensions
observations: Small, lightly drawn character icons accompany pale note-like cards on white. A horizontal sequence covers quick notes, organization, attachments, clipboard import, and settings. Get Started and backup import remain low on the screen, with dot progress beneath.
learning_candidate: Maintain an accessible entry point while the walkthrough explains several capabilities; the low-contrast treatment would need separate readability testing.
